title: Absolute value of an indexed sign monomial
statement: Let $\\iota$ be an index set, let $S\\subseteq\\iota$ be finite, and assign a sign to each index in $\\iota$. The absolute value of the product of the signs indexed by $S$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign is assigned to every index in $\\iota$
